manifest.name: Cyberpunk
manifest.author: CardSpoke Community
manifest.description: A dark neon theme with glowing accents, animated borders, and futuristic typography

css: :root { --bg-primary: #0a0a14; --bg-secondary: #12121f; --bg-card: #16162a; --text-primary: #e0e0ff; --text-secondary: #8888bb; --accent: #00ffcc; --accent-hover: #ff00aa; --border-color: #2a2a4a; --shadow-color: rgba(0,255,204,0.1); --neon-glow: 0 0 8px rgba(0,255,204,0.4), 0 0 16px rgba(0,255,204,0.1); } body { background-color: var(--bg-primary) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; font-family: 'Courier New', monospace !important; } .card, .card-item { background-color: var(--bg-card) !important; border: 1px solid var(--border-color) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px var(--shadow-color) !important; border-radius: 2px !important; transition: all 0.3s ease !important; } .card-item:hover { border-color: var(--accent) !important; box-shadow: var(--neon-glow) !important; } header, .header { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--bg-secondary) 0%, #1a1a30 50%, var(--bg-secondary) 100%) !important; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--accent) !important; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,255,204,0.15) !important; } button { background-color: transparent !important; border: 1px solid var(--accent) !important; color: var(--accent) !important; border-radius: 2px !important; text-transform: uppercase !important; letter-spacing: 1px !important; font-size: 11px !important; transition: all 0.2s ease !important; } button:hover { background-color: var(--accent) !important; color: var(--bg-primary) !important; box-shadow: var(--neon-glow) !important; } .modal-content, .menu-section { background-color: var(--bg-secondary) !important; border: 1px solid var(--accent) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; border-radius: 2px !important; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0,255,204,0.1), 0 0 40px rgba(0,255,204,0.05) !important; } input, textarea, select { background-color: var(--bg-primary) !important; border: 1px solid var(--border-color) !important; color: var(--accent) !important; border-radius: 2px !important; font-family: 'Courier New', monospace !important; } input:focus, textarea:focus { border-color: var(--accent) !important; outline: none !important; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(0,255,204,0.2), var(--neon-glow) !important; } .tag { background: transparent !important; color: var(--accent-hover) !important; border: 1px solid var(--accent-hover) !important; border-radius: 2px !important; padding: 2px 8px !important; font-family: 'Courier New', monospace !important; font-size: 0.8rem !important; text-transform: uppercase !important; } .breadcrumb a, a { color: var(--accent) !important; text-decoration: none !important; } .breadcrumb a:hover, a:hover { color: var(--accent-hover) !important; text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255,0,170,0.5) !important; } .toast { background-color: var(--bg-secondary) !important; color: var(--accent) !important; border-left: 3px solid var(--accent) !important; box-shadow: var(--neon-glow) !important; font-family: 'Courier New', monospace !important; } @keyframes cyberpunk-scan { 0% { opacity: 0.03; } 50% { opacity: 0.06; } 100% { opacity: 0.03; } } body::after { content: ''; position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent, transparent 2px, rgba(0,255,204,0.03) 2px, rgba(0,255,204,0.03) 4px); pointer-events: none; z-index: 9999; animation: cyberpunk-scan 4s ease-in-out infinite; }
